files.title: 阴雨教室：欢笑中的窗边孤独
files.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact graphite-pencil-and-watercolor rainy classroom illustration to CORRECT ONLY the foreground seating structure. Preserve the right-side brown-haired protagonist's face, hair, quiet gaze toward the rain, cheek-resting hand, clothing, color, size and position. Preserve the navy-haired foreground boy to his left, the background classmates, paper/watercolor style, composition, rainy overcast light, window structures and back wall.
The right protagonist and this foreground navy-haired boy must sit behind ONE NORMAL PAIRED DESK GROUP: two equal single-student wooden desktops touching edge-to-edge, with a visible seam BETWEEN the boys, about midway between their torsos. Join their desktop front edges on the same perspective line. REMOVE the empty aisle currently separating these two foreground desks; reconstruct coherent touching wood edges, metal front panels and legs. Preserve a real aisle outside this desk group, not between its two desk halves. The hero stays in the rightmost window-side half, the navy-haired deskmate in the left half. Never run the tabletop seam through either boy's body.
REMOVE the partial nearer row that intrudes across the very bottom foreground, including both large chair backs, partial table edges and the cropped sleeve at bottom left. Reveal the ordinary dry classroom floor beneath the main paired desk instead. The hero and his navy-haired deskmate each have exactly one chair BEHIND their body, hips on the seat, thighs and bent knees under their own desk half, natural navy trouser legs and two brown shoes resting on the floor with subtle contact shadows. No chair between camera and the pair's desks, no extra knees, shoes or dangling disconnected legs. The brown-haired student cropped at the far LEFT edge may remain as a distinct neighbor at the edge of his own desk, not a third seat in the main desk group. Do not change faces, poses or other students; this is a local furniture/foreground correction, not a new design. Keep every surface matte and paper-grained with cool cloudy light, no direct sunshine. Keep the same complete 16:9 landscape frame, no crop. No text, caption, interface, border, logo or watermark.
files.initial_generation_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: first of two full-frame 16:9 static concept frames for a Chinese literary short animation titled "窗"; no typography.
Primary request: Show a lonely boy in a crowded rainy Chinese high-school classroom, in a NON-PIXEL hand-drawn animation style, graphite pencil character outlines and restrained low-saturation watercolor backgrounds on subtly textured paper.
Scene and exact space: The camera is near the FRONT of the classroom looking toward the REAR; therefore the school's actual left-hand window wall appears on the RIGHT of this image. A single horizontal row of ordinary aluminum LEFT-RIGHT SLIDING windows with straight frames, horizontal tracks and a normal solid wall below its sill extends down the right wall. Outside is steady rain under a blue-gray OVERCAST sky. No sun, no golden shafts, no diagonal sunlit patches. The back wall has modest gray storage cabinets, a pinboard and stacked books. At least 16 other students occupy three orderly columns of paired desks, chatting in small groups or reading. Some study together, some lean toward a friend; natural, distinct posture and believable joints.
Main subject: An original slender 16-17-year-old boy with softly tousled chestnut-brown hair, a white collared shirt, dark teal vest, thin red tie, navy trousers and ordinary brown school shoes. He is in the foreground RIGHT window-side seat (the school's actual left side), slightly separated emotionally from the other students. His body is naturally seated in one wooden chair BEHIND HIS OWN SINGLE DESK, one of a pair of joined equal desks. The desk seam is distinctly to his LEFT, BETWEEN his and his navy-haired deskmate's desktop, never through his torso. The deskmate sits on his left and looks toward another classmate. The protagonist quietly rests his cheek on one hand and gazes toward the rainy window; the other forearm rests near an open notebook. Show natural shoulder/elbow/wrist connections, a small thoughtful mouth and correctly aligned subtle eyes, not oversized glossy chibi eyes. The chair is behind his back, hips supported by its seat, knees under his own desk, shoes resting on the floor. No empty extra chair in front, no floating pupils, no duplicated legs, no figure jammed between desks.
Style/medium: Authentic modest 2D animation keyframe; fine slightly irregular gray-brown graphite linework, gently simplified but convincing teen proportions around 6 heads tall; small soft facial features, quiet and sympathetic. Characters use matte watercolor and a little colored-pencil shading. Backgrounds use broad translucent watercolor washes, soft pigment pooling and airy paper-white breaks; fewer carefully chosen details. Paper texture is light and intrinsic to the paint, not a noisy overlay. Avoid slick polished anime rendering, shiny plastic skin, 3D, cinematic photorealism, dense digital stippling, extravagant lush decorative scenery, and all pixel/block edges.
Composition and mood: A clear horizontal film frame, protagonist fills about one-third of the width at right and is readable at medium distance, classmates recede to the left and back. Calm grounded camera, gentle ordinary school-life detail, loneliness within the room's social warmth. Palette is muted slate blue, pale cool gray, desaturated teal, faint warm brown wood and a little natural skin warmth. All indoor lighting is cool diffuse cloud light with modest ceiling illumination; shadows soft. There is no bright warm direct lighting indoors. Do not exaggerate sadness with tears or melodrama.
Text: NONE. No subtitles, title, captions, RPG interface, border, logos, watermark or montage. One complete large horizontal illustration.

files.title: 开窗之后：凉风与河流的想象
files.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied hand-drawn illustration into a SECOND narrative painting from the same prose film, keeping its exact pencil-and-muted-watercolor art direction and the recognizable SAME protagonist, rather than a different character.
Change the framing and scene to an intimate SIDE-PROFILE medium shot AFTER he has opened the classroom window. Newly draw him on the LEFT half of the image, seen from his right side and facing RIGHT toward the open window. Keep the same tousled chestnut hair, natural slender teenage proportions, small correctly aligned eyes, white shirt, subdued dark-teal vest, thin muted-red tie and modest graphite outlines. His expression now loosens: eyes gently closed, a small relaxed mouth, head just slightly lifted to feel the air, no tears, no grin or melodrama. His hand is no longer supporting his cheek: both arms rest naturally on his actual desk, one hand beside an open notebook. A small part of the notebook and lifted page corner can be seen in the bottom left. A faint real chair-back edge stays BEHIND his shoulder/back. Do not distort his neck, shoulders, hands or torso.
Recompose the setting rather than zooming or cropping the source: a narrow strip of the real classroom with softly painted distant classmates remains behind him at far left; most of the RIGHT half opens onto rainy air and the lyrical imagined river. The right window is an ordinary Chinese-school LEFT-RIGHT SLIDING window with straight vertical aluminum members and horizontal top and bottom tracks. Its two glass sashes are visibly slid sideways onto the side panels; the central opening contains NO glass, rain beads or reflected face. Outdoor drizzle remains outside. Keep a normal interior sill and solid wall below the window. The hero is still seated in the classroom; his furniture does not float and no river runs on the classroom floor.
Beyond the open window, the school trees and courtyard gradually dissolve through softly broken watercolor edges into a winding blue-green river that curves into rainy blue-hour distance and quiet indigo night. This is a visual metaphor of wind and freedom, continuous gentle washes, not a cutout picture in a window. Add very few lightly drifting leaf strokes and a lifted hair strand to express the breeze, not glowing particle effects. The indoor sketchwork stays concrete; the distant river uses sparse wet-on-wet watercolor washes, a few delicate colored-pencil ripples, soft cloud edges and natural paper-white reserves. Palette: cloudy pearl gray, desaturated sea green, slate blue, pale blue-green water, muted indigo horizon, subtle natural skin/wood warmth. Only cool diffuse rainy dusk light; NO sunbeams, sunset gold, golden floor stripes, blazing sparkles or glossy skin. Make the river less crowded with detail than the classroom, so the image can breathe. Authentic quiet 2D hand-drawn animation painting on lightly textured paper, fine irregular graphite contours and broad matte watercolor color fields. No pixelated or blocky rendering, no chibi proportions, no slick digital anime/3D/photorealism, no heavy all-frame noise.
Deliver one complete 16:9 horizontal painted film frame, with newly drawn side-view geometry and clear human anatomy. No subtitles, title, words, frame, logo, watermark, RPG UI, collage or multiple panels.
